tenderSchedule.title: Supply, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of Static Excitation System with Digital Automatic Voltage Regulator (DAVR) and Associated Equipment, Including Dismantling of Existing Panels, for 2 Units of 2X50 MW Supa Power House.
tenderSchedule.description: Design, engineering, manufacturing, quality surveillance, shop testing Inspection before dispatch, packing and forwarding, arranging for transit insurance on FOR destination basis. 02(two) sets of Static Excitation equipments each comprising the following. i.100 percent redundant two independent thyristor convertors of suitable capacity to cater to the maximum continuous and ceiling current requirements. ii.Digital automatic voltage regulator with dual auto and dual manual channels as redundancy, provided with all standard limiter functions, PSS facility parameter tuning and testing facilities, as per latest IEGC/SRPC stipulations on both Auto channels with required no. of Digital Input, Digital Output, Analog Input, Analog Output, 100 percent redundant power supply units, HMI & pushbuttons along with standard protections to provide total Excitation system functionality. iii.Field flashing (both AC & DC) for excitation start up. iv.Field breaker and field discharge & suppression equipments. One set of Essential spares (Mandatary spares. ERECTION, TESTING & COMMISSIONING Dismantling of existing system, erection, testing & commissioning of the above new equipments in complete to provide complete functionality of static excitation system.
